description: A site operations director must finalize seating for a three-person client-support team moving to a new floor, including the placement of employees with relationship and workplace-support considerations.

shared_context.S1: The three-person client-support team is moving to a new floor with four assigned desks: North-1, North-2, South-1, and South-2.
shared_context.S2: North-1 and North-2 are in the quieter area, while South-1 and South-2 are in the collaborative area.
shared_context.S3: Valerie has authority to publish the team's final seating map and any associated follow-up actions.
shared_context.S4: As part of the move process, Valerie routinely checks with Noah, Priya, and HR before publishing a seating map; once each has spoken and no new concern is raised, she may publish without waiting for input from anyone else.
shared_context.S5: The seating map must assign each team member to one desk, and any unused desk is recorded as unassigned.

PF1.text: After a facilitated discussion last month, Mina and Jules agreed that Mina would use the quieter North area and Jules would use the collaborative South area for the first 30 days, so they would not work in the same zone; the written agreement has not yet been added to the move roster.

PF2.text: Priya has an approved sensory accommodation requiring the quieter North-1 desk, but the accommodation is not shown on the preliminary seating map.

PF3.text: The current workplace-adjustment policy requires Valerie to confirm an approved seating accommodation privately with the employee and schedule a review exactly 30 days after the move; Andre confirmed this in a policy check this week, before the move packet was finalized.

acceptance_conditions: Mina must be assigned to North-2 and Jules must be assigned to South-1, preserving their agreed separation by work area.
Priya must be assigned to North-1 to implement her approved accommodation.
South-2 must be recorded as the unused desk.
Valerie must privately confirm the accommodation with Priya.
The accommodation review must be scheduled exactly 30 days after the move.
A private accommodation-confirmation commitment must be recorded.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'private_confirmation' and c['target'] == 'Priya' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed
provenance_checks.P3: 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The prior agreement changes Mina's assignment to North-2 and Jules's assignment to South-1 instead of allowing a generic seating arrangement.
Priya's approved accommodation changes her assignment to the exact North-1 desk rather than an ordinary available seat.
The policy confirmation changes the follow-up from no required accommodation process to a private confirmation commitment and an exactly 30-day review.
